meaning:
ἥττημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX for מַס, Isa.31:8 * ;]
defect, loss, defeat: Rom.11:12 (cf. Isa, l.with), 1Co.6:7 (cf. Field, Notes, 160 f., 171 f.; Lft., Notes, 212).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
